title: Target-Aware Implementation of Real Expressions
problem: Numerical code running on low-precision accelerators and vector ISAs must simultaneously maximize accuracy and performance, but traditional compiler backends optimize for specific targets without accuracy reasoning, while numerical compilers trade accuracy vs. performance without considering the target hardware environment.
motivation: New low-precision accelerators and vector instruction sets make it increasingly challenging to correctly balance accuracy and performance of floating-point numerical code, a gap neither traditional nor numerical compilers alone can bridge.
method: Chassis takes a mathematical expression and generates multiple implementations for a specific target—like a GPU, a vector ISA (the instructions for processing multiple numbers at once), or optimized library functions—each offering different trade-offs between accuracy and speed. It measures how accurate and how fast each implementation will be on that hardware. Then it picks and generates the code for whichever implementation works best for that target by optimizing both accuracy and speed together, based on what the hardware can actually do.
key_novelty: A compiler that improves both numerical accuracy and speed at the same time, designed for specific hardware and instruction sets, doing what traditional compiler backends and numerical compilers used to do separately.
contributions: Chassis: a target-aware numerical compiler that bridges traditional and numerical compilation
Joint accuracy-performance optimization conditioned on target-environment capabilities
Support for low-precision accelerators, vector instruction sets, and library functions
Demonstrated ability to improve both accuracy and performance simultaneously on real targets

metrics.accuracy: improved or maintained vs. baselines (specific numbers not in abstract)

limitations: Scope and scalability to large numerical programs not discussed in abstract.
primary_theme: target-aware numerical compiler for accuracy-performance co-optimization
